title: Inter-team Dependency Beacon and Cutover Windows Coordination
creator: Elena Morales
description: Problem: Roadmap cutovers frequently collide across teams (Eng/Design/Security/Infra). Current dependency trackers are disparate (spreadsheets, linear issues, Slack threads) and lack a lightweight signal that both humans and machines can act on when a dependency changes status. Proposal: Build an 'Inter-team Dependency Beacon' — a compact, standardized signal attached to roadmap items that encodes dependency criticality, earliest/latest cutover windows, automated calendar reservations, escalation lane, and a machine-readable runbook pointer. The beacon will appear in the Console roadmap view, the Linear issue sidebar, and publish an iCal/Scheduling feed for cutover windows. Objective: reduce cross-team cutover conflicts by 60% and cut decision latency for blocked rollouts by 40% in the first quarter after rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Beacon schema defined and approved by Eng/Design/Security/Infra (versioned JSON schema)
Console roadmap shows beacon badge with criticality, window, and one-click view of runbook
Linear issue sidebar displays beacon status and provides one-click calendar reservation for owners
Automated escalation triggers to on-call or triage channel when a dependency moves to "blocked" within 48 hours of a cutover window
Pilot run with three cross-functional initiatives completed and post-pilot survey shows improved clarity (>= 80% teams report improvement)
Telemetry: number of cutover overlaps in pilot cohort reduced >=60% vs baseline
tasks: Design beacon schema and wireframes (PM + Design)
Implement lightweight API and storage for beacon attachments (Infra)
Console UI: badge, modal with runbook and calendar link (Frontend)
Linear integration: sidebar card and deep links to beacon modal (Eng)
Escalation rules engine: map criticality to on-call / slack channel (Reliability)
Pilot with Payments, Search, and Console teams; collect feedback and metrics
